message_text: Additional details: the size ratio is S:M:L:XL = 20:40:30:10. The fabric must be 180gsm pure cotton, in white only, with each item in an individual OPP bag and 12 pieces per carton. Payment terms of 30% advance T/T and the balance against a copy of the bill of lading are acceptable. OEKO-TEX certification is preferred.
